$schema_note: Single source of truth for every price the site, emails, and the checkout server show. Change a number here, not in a generator or a template. See docs/specs/goals-2027-funnel-spec.md D18.

race_plan_4weekly.name: Custom Training Plan
race_plan_4weekly.source_note: Mirrors athlete-custom-training-plan-pipeline webhook/race_plan_subscription.py (BLOCK_PRICE_CENTS, WEEK_PRICE_CENTS = block price / 4 rounded up to the cent, weeks_until, payment_plan, REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS). The server has no quote endpoint, so every price the site shows must use this exact math; tests/test_race_plan_4weekly_pricing.py pins it.

race_plan.name: Custom Training Plan
inclusions: One race, periodised to your A-race date
Delivered to your TrainingPeaks calendar within 24 hours
race_plan.retired_note: Retired for new sales 2026-11-13 (Matti, SUBSCRIPTION_DESIGN.md §8.7): race_plan_4weekly replaces it on every Gravel God page. The checkout server keeps the race_plan path for orders already paid, so these numbers stay for reconciliation and for the Roadie Labs pages and emails that have not switched yet. Never quote them on a Gravel God page.

season_plan.name: Season Plan
season_plan.retired_note: Retired 2026-10-23 (Matti: one product). Not offered anywhere on the site and the checkout server refuses it (410). Kept so past reconciliation labels and the success page still resolve.
inclusions: Up to 52 weeks, the whole season
Every A/B/C race of the year periodised
Delivered to your TrainingPeaks calendar within 3 days
Four scheduled rebuilds across the year

labour_budget.note: Coach-hours budget per athlete per year. Only holds if Motoren performs the rebuilds (docs/specs/goals-2027-funnel-spec.md D16). Rebuild automation is out of scope here.

coaching.summary: A human coach and a plan that adjusts weekly.
